priorityList: Charge the target to engage or if out of melee range.
Maintain Rend on the target, refreshing it if it has expired or is about to expire.
Use Ravager when Colossus Smash is ready or nearly off cooldown.
Cast Avatar and Colossus Smash (or Warbreaker) together as your primary damage window.
Use Champion's Spear while the target has the Colossus Smash debuff or during Avatar.
Cast Demolish while the target has the Colossus Smash debuff, ideally at high stacks of Colossal Might.
In Execute phase, cast Mortal Strike if you have 2 stacks of Executioner's Precision.
Cast Mortal Strike on cooldown to maintain Deep Wounds and generate Overpower charges.
Cast Overpower whenever available to generate Martial Prowess stacks.
Use Execute whenever available during the Execute phase (target below 20% health, or 35% with Massacre).
Use Execute immediately whenever a Sudden Death proc occurs.
Use Wrecking Throw if no other priority abilities are available.
Use Slam as a filler if you have excess Rage and all higher-priority abilities are on cooldown.
